[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:383YE Winter]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Proposed by Temeschwar, Seconded by Casinea">Construct the Cathedral of the Navigators, a Temple of the Way, in the Sarcophan Delves, creating the title "Bishop of the Navigators".

Appointment to be through the General Assembly of the Synod</quote>

{{CaptionedImage|file=Starcathedral.jpg|caption=Final impression of the planned cathedral of the Navigators.|align=right|width=600}}
==Overview==
* Motion to construct a Temple of the Way in the [[Sarcophan Delves]] as detailed in the '''[[All_at_sea#The_Temple_of_the_Way_in_Sarcophan|All at sea]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
* Passed at 50 thrones

==Date==
* Winter 383YE
==Cost==
* Non-standard costs apply
* 40 wains of white granite
* 30 wains of mithril
* 140 crowns in labour costs
* 6 months to construct 
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Cathedral_of_the_Navigators}}
==Outcome==
* 50 thrones disbursed to the Senator for Temeschwar
* Once the Cathedral of the Navigators is completed the [[Bishop of the Navigators]] will be able to be appointed by the [[Assembly#General_Assembly|General Assembly]]
{{CaptionedImage|file=Temple thumbnails3.jpg|caption=Early proposals for the planned cathedral of the Navigators.|align=left|width=1000}}
